limits: Counterpart verification covers exactly the80upstream cases and187source Assert expressions;it is not proof of the full behavioral/public-API/resource/native specification.

Most source tests use process-wide KeyboardResources.Default and TestHelpers.SharedModels. Native fixtures use explicit fresh resources/models and deterministic disposal;process-wide identity,thread safety,cache scope and CLR GC remain incomplete.
Touch native fixture also binds the engine clock to the deterministic scheduler;source touch fixture does not. Timing tests establish those assertions,not all ordering or timer lifecycle behavior.
Readme engine test uses the explicit deterministic Harness instead of the exact source default constructor path. Global-default constructor parity remains separately incomplete.
Text source theory four rows share one Rust test containing the four source assertions plus an extra boundary case;some source methods intentionally map to combined existing native tests.

Layout diagnostics use native key code because ComputedKey.ToString public source contract remains unmapped. That does not weaken the success assertions but does not port failure-diagnostic formatting.
Source xUnit assembly/test-host/build tooling maps to Cargo/Rust test discovery;CLR test classes and helper object identities are not asserted equal.
Native application interaction and platform scope remain unverified;pending Mac unlock is not bypassed. Reflection method-binding lifetime and all other recorded full-goal gaps remain open.
